headline: Sensex and Nifty end lower as banking and pharma drag, while IT stocks and Reliance Jio IPO news provide support.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Selling pressure in banking, pharma, and auto sectors weighed on the market.
Hot US inflation data boosted expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
Investors booked profits following a massive 1,100-point rally in the previous session.
IT stocks like Infosys and TCS rallied, helping to cushion the overall market decline.
whatHappening: Reliance Jio filed its RHP and announced IPO subscription dates for October 21-23.
Bajaj Consumer Care reported a 66% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 70 crore.
The government proposed tougher BS VII pollution norms, including real-world emission tests for vehicles.
Noel and Neville Tata filed legal caveats in Mumbai courts regarding the Tata Trusts row.
summary: The Indian market ended lower on October 14, with the Sensex falling 252 points to settle at 72,781.89. While IT stocks like Infosys and TCS rallied, sectors such as banking and pharma faced selling pressure following hot US inflation data. Key highlights included Reliance Jio's IPO announcement and strong quarterly earnings from Bajaj Consumer Care.
